desc: 水花悬浮渐变天空的防晒套图模版，冰蓝粉紫梦幻水感
name: 水花渐变梦幻水感防晒霜款

shots.intent: 首屏用水花悬浮与渐变天空赢一眼点击，承接水感轻薄的卖点
shots.textZone: top center headline 「{selling_point_1}」 with a smaller subline 「{selling_point_2}」

shots.intent: 一秒传达核心使用感受，用三个细线圆标陈列关键卖点
shots.textZone: bottom row of three icon chips labeled 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」

shots.intent: 放大日常场景中的防晒焦虑，建立不做防护的代价感
shots.textZone: 2x2 quadrant grid, each card pairing a scenario label 「{callout_4}」 with a short worry line 「{callout_5}」

shots.intent: 让买家代入晴天出门前的真实使用时刻，强化随身常备感
用微距质地证明水感轻薄的肤感主张，替代不可验证的功效文案
用厚乳与水感质地的同框对比，把黏腻痛点转化为选择理由
shots.textZone: one short label above each panel reading 「{callout_6}」 and 「{callout_7}」

shots.intent: 用结构化参数表回答品名与适用范围等基础疑问，空值交由后期填充
shots.textZone: spec table on the left with row labels 「{callout_8}」 and all value cells left blank for post-fill

shots.intent: 以留空报告框降低决策风险，真实资质留待后期合规填充
以仰角气势与水花冠收口促单，用行动按钮完成转化
shots.textZone: rounded CTA button reading 「{callout_9}」 in the lower third

style.backgroundSystem: airy blue-to-lilac gradient skies #AFC6EA into #E9D9F0 for hero and accent shots, icy white #F4F8FE panels for info shots, all with a soft watery glow
style.iconSystem: thin-line round icon chips in a single indigo accent
style.lightingSystem: cool soft studio light with an upper-left key, dreamy glow, soft contact shadows and watery specular highlights
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dreamy water-feel sunscreen visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of misty cloud blue #AFC6EA, soft lilac pink #E9D9F0, indigo text accent #4653C6 and icy white #F4F8FE; cool soft studio lighting with an upper-left key, gentle dreamy glow, soft contact shadows and watery specular highlights; modern geometric sans-serif; thin-line round icon chips in a single indigo accent; clean high-end skincare photography blended with airy water-splash renders and minimal infographic elements; stable upright product presentation with consistent scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: upright floating or standing bottle, stable scale, centered with airy water-splash accents
style.surfaceSystem: matte light-stone counter #E8EDF4 for scenes and a glossy reflective floor for standing products
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, indigo #4653C6 headlines, short labels only
